author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Bad Ice-Cream

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend.
Your friend types the code in Join by code, or picks your room in the Rooms list.
The game window opens on both PCs once your friend has joined.
tips: Two players on two PCs. The host is Player 1 and only the host's mouse works in the menus.
Both players need the same Ruffle Together build and the same game file; the launcher keeps them current.
No room code? Under Other ways to connect, Host with your IP starts a game on port 7790; your friend copies your address and port, then presses Join by IP.
The same game file plays co-op on one keyboard (Settings, Show offline play).

description: Collect all the fruit in each maze while building and breaking ice walls to stay away from the monsters. Better with a friend. Online co-op runs in Ruffle Together: the host is Player 1, the friend joins as Player 2.

actions.label: Play online
actions.description: Host a room, or join one with a code
actions.hint: Send the room code the message shows to your friend. The game opens once they join. Move with arrows or WASD, ice with Space, Enter or F.

actions.label: Host with your IP
actions.hint: Friends copy your address and port (for example 192.168.1.20:7790) and press Join by IP. Radmin, Tailscale and LAN addresses work.

actions.label: Join by IP
actions.hint: The game opens once you are connected to the host.

actions.label: Play on one keyboard
actions.description: Co-op for two on this PC
